verdict.rationale: Composio ships a programmatic SDK (session creation via API, no UI required), a CLI usable from terminals/scripts, an OpenAPI spec for direct API automation, and explicit unattended authentication (`composio login --agent`) designed to sign in without a browser — all core requirements for CI/headless automation. Missing for 10: no explicit CI/CD pipeline example (e.g., GitHub Actions) or independent confirmation of headless runs in production.
